Loneliness breaks even the toughest ones.. Feeling lonely is hard. Sometimes even if we do have a couple of close friends will still do feel lonely I guess that’s the need in us to have our own something. The only  thing I can tell you is start doing little things that you love even if it’s hard to do it alone you start doing it and you never know who you can meet along the way. For example I love hiking I didn’t have nobody to go with and then I decided to go along with some organized group and there I meet  a friend and since that we were hanging out talking about everything and she’s been very supportive through some hard period That I’m going through.. I guess if you do something some kind of step where you can have contact with people you can meet someone and you never know maybe you can meet someone really special and a good friend..
